Give each Best of N fork a full clone of your workspace, including its local commit history. Choosing a winner then gives your workspace that fork's state, so the commits it made are kept. Forks take longer to create than the default CitC clone. See go/jetski-best-of-n.

Give each Best of N fork its own clone of your Git repository instead of a copy-on-write overlay. Each fork is then a real repository, so commits it makes are kept when you choose it as the winner. Forks take longer to create, and the wait grows with the size of your repository. See go/jetski-best-of-n.
